mechanism_class: energy-shield overleech ABOVE maximum (above-cap sustain buffer)
spec_text_or_path: A defensive layer whose durability comes from banking recovered resource ABOVE the normal max cap -- Grim Feast (0.2-dawn) vacuums life remnants from enemy deaths and stacks them onto Energy Shield up to 2x the ES maximum (overleech past cap). The engine resource_economy has on_kill recovery keys (map the intake) but NO key expressing an ABOVE-MAXIMUM buffer -- i.e. recovered resource that persists as extra ceiling rather than topping-off toward a fixed cap. This above-cap overflow IS the kit's identity (tankiness from the 2x-cap buffer, not from the intake rate). Same above-cap class also attested at blood-mage (0.1 'healing above max life to 150%', b01). Steward consolidates the overheal/overleech-above-cap class per §B watch-item.
